items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: So I said, “What does that represent?” He said, “I told you! I said a cade, didn’t I? Anyway, Bob Thomson... but you know what? He would get in addition to his tragic magic he would drink a lot at the Five Spot place and he get up strippers and stuff. But he was like... But there were a lot of painters... [Dorothy talks in the background]...Huh? Who?

Oh yeah, but something else people don't know, there were a lot of writers and stuff that would hangout cause I like to read, but this is really deep. Them guys used to come around from Melbrook, Timothy Leery and Alpred and stuff, and me and here being in Mingus we'd go up there and they huge melonous estate and they'd give us acid and stuff from Switzerland...
